snippet.title: I made Tiny Glade, but Brutalist (now on steam!)
snippet.description:
WISHLIST TINY BRUTALISM NOW ON STEAM https://store.steampowered.com/app/5426130/Tiny_Brutalism/

NEW DISCORD- Send Suggestions and share your work. https://discord.gg/qE5Xyu8B7z

TINY BRUTALISM
a relaxing diorama sandbox builder inspired by brutalist architecture

Create strange monuments, impossible structures, concrete towers, or just a really big wall. Then explore inside them in first person. There’s no goal and no right way to build. Make whatever you feel like making


#indiegame  #gamedev  #brutalism  #tinyglade #steam
